description:
No spec subject — test hygiene follow-up.

Surfaced by the elixir-test-critic while grading specled_-dn4.12 iteration 3 (epic specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27), and explicitly graded NON-BLOCKING there. Filed rather than bounced because dn4.12 was at its bounce cap and this is a "should"-level hygiene point, not a defect in what that ticket delivered.

test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs (~:85 and ~:91) names the ephemeral beam directory with `:erlang.unique_integer([:positive])`:

    Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "specled_paths_ephemeral_#{uid}")

.spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach.md (as amended by specled_-ehv, already merged) says at its Decision section: "New tests that allocate shared-tmp roots should reach for `SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0` as well." This test allocates a shared-tmp root, so the guidance applies.

WHY IT IS A REAL (SMALL) HAZARD, per the critic: specled runs NESTED — a merged `mix spec.check` executes host-project tests that may themselves exercise specled — and both VMs share `System.tmp_dir!()`. `:erlang.unique_integer([:positive])` restarts low in each fresh VM, so two concurrent VMs can mint the same directory name. On collision, the first `File.rm_rf!` (paths_test.exs:~115) deletes the other VM tree before its force-load at ~:126, failing that test RED for a reason unrelated to the code under test.

FIX (one line, supplied by the critic):

    Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "specled_paths_ephemeral_#{SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix()}")

Keep `uid` for the MODULE NAME only — the module name needs to be unique within the VM, not across VMs, and changing it is unnecessary churn.

DO NOT change where the beam is written. It must stay outside `Mix.Project.compile_path()` and outside `test/test_support/`; putting it in either reproduces the coverage-tally defect that cost dn4.12 two bounces (`:code.purge` on a cover-compiled module drops it from both numerator and denominator of the `--cover` tally). Verify with:
  mix test --cover test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs
SpecLedEx.Review.CoverageClosure must keep its row and there must be no "Failed to collect coverage information" warning.

Also confirm both `ensure_module/2` collapse mutants still turn the discrimination test RED after the change.

Deliberately left standalone rather than admitted into specled_-k6s: that epic is mid-flight and this did not go through its admission gate.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: (none — test hygiene, no spec subject)

BLOCKED BY specled_-dn4.12 — HARD BLOCKER, newly recorded by the orchestrator.
test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs DOES NOT EXIST at the epic base bb64e69e
(`git ls-tree bb64e69e test/specled_ex/coverage/` lists aggregate, boundary, formatter,
mfa_key, mfa_lines, snapshot, store — no paths_test). The file is CREATED by dn4.12 commit
2190cfcb, and every line this ticket targets is dn4.12's. Do not start before dn4.12 has
merged; there is nothing to edit. Re-locate the lines after it lands rather than trusting the
numbers below.

Allowed touches: test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs ONLY.

CHANGE, at paths_test.exs:91 (post-dn4.12 numbering may differ):
  Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "specled_paths_ephemeral_#{SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix()}")
Keep `uid = :erlang.unique_integer([:positive])` at :85 for the MODULE NAME only — that needs
VM-local uniqueness, not cross-VM, and changing it is unnecessary churn.
SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0 exists at the epic base (lib/specled_ex/temp_name.ex:18),
so there is no dependency on unlanded work beyond dn4.12 itself.

Out of Scope (files):
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach.md (already amended by
  specled_-ehv, merged)
- everything else.

Out of Scope (intent):
- Do NOT move where the ephemeral beam is written. It must stay outside
  Mix.Project.compile_path() and outside test/test_support/. Either relocation reproduces the
  coverage-tally defect that cost dn4.12 two bounces: :code.purge on a cover-compiled module
  drops it from both numerator and denominator of the --cover tally.

Verification:
  mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs
  mix test --cover test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs
    -> SpecLedEx.Review.CoverageClosure must keep its row, and there must be NO
       "Failed to collect coverage information" warning
  Confirm both ensure_module/2 collapse mutants still turn the discrimination test
    (paths_test.exs:128) RED
  mix format --check-formatted

Expected diff: 1 file, 1 line.

Mechanical checks:
- Files touched: 1 (test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs, +4/-1 vs base 06860c75; the +4/-1 is formatter line-wrapping of the single logical change, not extra edits)
- ADR file untouched: CONFIRMED — `git diff --name-only 06860c75..HEAD -- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach.md` is empty
- Working tree clean after mutant work: CONFIRMED (`git status --porcelain` empty; mutants built and torn down on a scratch rsync copy outside the repo)

Semantic checks:
- cross_vm_suffix/0 genuinely solves cross-VM collision: YES. lib/specled_ex/temp_name.ex:18-20 returns "#{System.pid()}_#{Base.encode16(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(6), case: :lower)}" — the OS pid separates concurrently live VMs, and 6 bytes of CSPRNG hex (12 chars) covers pid reuse against stale same-name leftovers. :erlang.unique_integer([:positive]) has neither property: it is a per-VM counter that restarts low in every fresh VM, so two nested/parallel VMs sharing System.tmp_dir!() can mint the identical root. Not cargo-cult.
- ADR actually recommends it: YES. specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names_reach.md:77-78 — "New tests that allocate shared-tmp roots should reach for `SpecLedEx.TempName.cross_vm_suffix/0` as well." The test allocates its own shared-tmp root, and ADR:65-67 puts allocate-your-own-root tests squarely in the "shall name that root with cross_vm_suffix/0" half. The ADR:50-57 accepted-risk carve-out covers only EXISTING unique_integer test roots, and ADR:112 says so explicitly — it does not cover a newly created test like this one.
- VM-local uid KEPT for the module name: CONFIRMED. paths_test.exs:85 still has `uid = :erlang.unique_integer([:positive])` and :86 still builds the module name from it; `grep -n uid` returns exactly those two lines. No churn.
- BEAM location unmoved (outside compile_path and test_support): CONFIRMED. paths_test.exs:91-94 still roots at `System.tmp_dir!()`; the beam is written at :105 to Path.join(tmp_dir, "#{mod}.beam") and the dir is added to the code path at :106 via :code.add_patha. Neither Mix.Project.compile_path() nor test/test_support/ appears anywhere in the changed hunk or the test. Only the name of the directory changed; the location is byte-identical in structure.
- Coverage tally intact: CONFIRMED. Row present: `83.69% | SpecLedEx.Review.CoverageClosure` (also `88.89% | SpecLedEx.Coverage.Paths`). NO "Failed to collect coverage information" warning — grep -i "Failed to collect" over BOTH captured stdout and stderr of the --cover run returned zero matches (grep exit 1), and stderr was entirely empty. Tests: 39 tests, 0 failures.
- Discrimination mutants still killed: BOTH RED.

  - collapse-to-:code.is_loaded (`defp ensure_module(module, _load?) do match?({_kind, _loaded_path}, :code.is_loaded(module)) end`): RED at test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs:129 — `assert Paths.module_source(mod, true) == expected`, left: nil, right: "lib/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test_ephemeral.ex".
  Both were built on a scratch copy at a throwaway path and the copy was deleted; the repo tree was never mutated. Baseline on the scratch copy was green (9 tests, 0 failures) before each mutant.
- on_exit cleanup removes the dir it created: CONFIRMED. `tmp_dir` is bound once at :90-94 and is the same binding used by File.mkdir_p! (:96), the beam write (:105), :code.add_patha (:106), and inside the on_exit closure at :117-118 (:code.del_path + File.rm_rf!). The rename cannot desynchronize creator and remover because there is only one binding.
- Targeted verification (all in the stage worktree /Users/mz/src/specled_ex-cross-vm-ephemeral-beam):
  - `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` — clean
  - `mix format --check-formatted` — clean (exit 0)
  - `mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs` — 9 tests, 0 failures
  - `mix test --cover test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs` — 39 tests, 0 failures; CoverageClosure row present; no collection warning
- Full-suite verification: not run by verifier (by design)

Verdict: PASS

Gaps (if FAIL): none

Notes (advisory only):
- The --cover command exits 3 with "Coverage test failed, threshold not met: Coverage 3.65% / Threshold 82.00%". That is the project-wide 82% threshold judged against a two-file run — an artifact of the partial invocation, not a regression. The contract's actual assertions (CoverageClosure row present, no collection warning) both hold, and every test in the run passed. Worth knowing so a future runner does not read exit 3 as a failure of this ticket.
